## Data centers

The one issue that has resonated with voters, not only in Alabama but nationwide, is the sudden opposition to AI data center projects.

Polling suggest overwhelming opposition to data centers built in their local areas.

A Gallup poll in May shows that 71% oppose them, including half who are strongly opposed. [...] Of those, 68.5% were Republican voters as the party swept every statewide constitutional office.
